subject: Security & deployment info request — Private/VPC vs air-gapped options
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah@lyrahealthtech.com>, Tom Vargas <tvargas@lyrahealthtech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security & deployment info request — Private/VPC vs air-gapped options

Hi Sarah / Tom — great to meet today. Quick recap from our discovery + a short list of asks so we can qualify the Private/VPC and air-gapped options for Lyra: 

1) Compliance posture
  - SOC 2: you mentioned Type II is in progress. Can you confirm anticipated completion date and whether you can share the SOC 2 report or an SOC 2 readiness attestation?
  - HIPAA: please confirm if Lyra is a HIPAA-covered entity and whether BAAs are required for vendor operating access to PHI.
  - GDPR: do you process EU personal data and will you need a DPA (we can provide our template)?

2) Deployment requirements
  - Primary ask: are you targeting a VPC peering/private endpoint model or a fully air-gapped/on-prem deploy for your initial pilots? You referenced both — if you can rank by priority that helps.
  - Network diagram: please share a sanitized architecture diagram showing where inference traffic will originate and any on-prem connectors.
  - Data residency: required regions for data at rest/processing.

3) Security questionnaire & artifacts
  - I attached our vendor security questionnaire (Lyra_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf) — please complete the red sections and return.
  - If you have a procurement/security pack (e.g., current SOC 2 report, ISO cert, pen test), please share via Drive or your secure portal.

4) Technical specifics we’ll need to qualify risk and architect the right offering:
  - Intended throughput (concurrent requests / peak tokens per minute) and latency SLOs.
  - Whether you require customer-managed keys/HSM (we support CMEK options and HSM integrations in Private).
  - Whether egress is allowed at all from the environment or needs strict deny-by-default for external traffic (affects air-gap feasibility).

Next steps: if you can return the questionnaire and the sanitized diagram this week, Neha (cc'd from our security team) will review and we’ll schedule a 45-minute technical design call next week to walk options (VPC peering, dedicated private, air-gapped). Also please loop in your procurement contact or let me know who to nudge.

Attachments: Lyra_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (please complete)

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com

From: Sarah Li <sarah@lyrahealthtech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Vargas <tvargas@lyrahealthtech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & deployment info request — Private/VPC vs air-gapped options

Thanks Rishi — and thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: Type II in progress, expected audit completion around 2027-05-20. We can share our interim SOC attestation and a scope doc by EOD Wednesday.
- HIPAA: Lyra is a HIPAA-covered business associate for a subset of customers — BAAs will be required for any configuration that handles PHI.
- GDPR: yes, we process EU data for some customers; we'll need a DPA. Please send your template.

On deployment: our initial pilot should be VPC peering with very strict egress rules. We have a small set of workloads that may require an air-gapped option (regulated partner) later this year — we want to understand the delta in effort/cost.

I uploaded a sanitized version of our current architecture to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bLyraSanitizedArch — the file is Lyra_sanitized_architecture_v1.pdf.

Procurement: procurement@lyrahealthtech.com is the right contact; cc'ing them on next threads.

We'll start filling the questionnaire and should have an initial pass by Thursday. Happy to schedule the technical call next week — Tue/Wed mornings PT work best for us.

— Sarah
Sarah Li
Director, Product Security | Lyra HealthTech
sarah@lyrahealthtech.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & deployment info request — Private/VPC vs air-gapped options

Looping in a few items I want us to capture before the technical call with Lyra: 

1) Evidence requests (we should ask explicitly):
  - Interim SOC attestation + expected report date (Sarah said 2027-05-20).
  - Pen test exec summary and remediation status.
  - Encryption at rest: confirmation of CMKs or cloud-managed keys; for Private deployments we need to know whether they require customer-managed KMS/HSM.
  - Logging & retention: required retention window for audit logs and whether they need access to raw logs.

2) Network/security constraints to confirm on call:
  - VPC peering vs Private endpoint (we need their preference and any firewall restrictions).
  - Egress policy: if egress must be zero then air-gapped/on-prem path will be required; note this adds delivery time and professional services effort.
  - Ports/protocols allowed for management plane (we should supply a minimal whitelist).

3) Data classification & PHI handling: We need a sample data flow for PHI-tagged traffic (what is redacted, where is PHI stored and who has access).

Action items for us before the call: prepare a short "deployment options matrix" (VPC peering vs Dedicated Private vs Air-gapped) with pros/cons, expected lead times, and rough cost multipliers. I'll draft the security checklist and default RBAC suggestions and attach our private deployment diagram (redwood_private_arch_diagram_v2.png) to the invite.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com

From: Tom Vargas <tvargas@lyrahealthtech.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Li <sarah@lyrahealthtech.com>
Cc: procurement@lyrahealthtech.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & deployment info request — Private/VPC vs air-gapped options

Appreciate the notes. Attached is a sanitized architecture (Lyra_sanitized_architecture_v1.pdf) — it shows our customer-facing frontends in GCP, inference requests routed through a secure gateway, and a small on-prem connector for legacy customers. 

A few clarifications / questions from my side: 
- We plan VPC peering for the pilot; egress will be allowed but strictly to a short list of destinations. For the regulated partner, we will likely need a fully air-gapped option (no outbound internet) — curious on your approach for software updates/patching in that model.
- Do you support customer-managed HSM integrations (FIPS 140-2/3) for key material?
- What are the minimal management ports you need open for health checks/agent management if we choose the dedicated private path?

We can do Tue 2027-04-13 09:30 PT for the technical call. If that works for you, please send a calendar invite with the agenda.

Thanks,
Tom Vargas
Head of Infrastructure | Lyra HealthTech
tvargas@lyrahealthtech.com

[Attachment: Lyra_sanitized_architecture_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & deployment info request — Private/VPC vs air-gapped options

Thanks team — Tue 09:30 PT works for us. Agenda I propose:
  1) Quick recap of Lyra requirements (5m)
  2) Review sanitized architecture + clarify egress/peering needs (10m)
  3) Deployment options matrix (VPC peering / Dedicated Private / Air-gapped) — Neha to walk security/tradeoffs (15m)
  4) Key integration questions: CMEK/HSM, patch/update plan for air-gapped installs, logging access and retention (10m)
  5) Action items & procurement timeline (5m)

Action items I’ll own before the call: draft and share the deployment options matrix and invite with the agenda + attach redwood_private_arch_diagram_v2.png and the questionnaire we asked them to fill. Neha will bring the security checklist and required evidence list.

See you on the call — I’ll send the invite in a few minutes.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
